title: Material, two answers, team next step

source.title: Book more calls from your comments
source.original_goal: Book more calls from your comments
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.inputs_text: question_one, question_two, qualification_policy, next_step; resource_title/resource_url together if material; booking_url only for booking_link.
native.messages_text: "Here is {resource_title}: {resource_url}. Would you like to answer two questions for the coach?" Omit the material sentence when absent. After new localized affirmative consent, ask the two approved questions separately.
native.end_stop: Both actual answers and confirmed team handoff or approved booking destination; S. A link is not a booked call.

use_when: People request a resource or coach contact through a named post keyword and agree to two intake questions.
prerequisites: Prepare two questions, qualification criteria and either a team route or an existing booking URL. Material title and accessible URL are optional together.
exclude_when: Do not choose when a button-driven qualification graph or completed appointment is mandatory.
Do not configure when required lifecycle operations are unavailable on the actual host.

steps.action: Actual matching keyword comment on the selected post.
Send the exact approved first message. Deliver any promised value now.
Stated outcome only. No inferred booking, registration, purchase, verified follow or verified share.
Require new affirmative consent for this run. Entry word and consent do not count as answers.
Ask exactly the approved first question; wait for its actual answer.
Ask exactly the approved second question; wait for a distinct actual answer.
Apply qualification_policy: appropriate, inappropriate and unclear. Do not invent answers.
Provide approved booking_url only for next_step=booking_link. Do not claim completed booking.
End this campaign on refusal. Do not restart from a keyword in the refusal.
Send nothing for silence or external clicks; enforce current delivery windows.
Same-run repeat does not restart intake, resend a bonus or duplicate capture. Ambiguous late replies need clarification.
Use native team handoff on person request, unresolved facts or approved handoff criteria. Text alone is not handoff proof.
